name: referral-tracking
author: Nolan Seokane
description: Mono repo for the Referral Tracking eco system

scripts.db:generate: docker compose exec referral-tracking-api pnpm --dir /workspace/api run generate
scripts.db:migrate: docker compose exec referral-tracking-api pnpm --dir /workspace/api run migrate
scripts.db:seed: docker compose exec referral-tracking-api pnpm --dir /workspace/api run seed
scripts.db:bootstrap-admin: docker compose exec referral-tracking-api pnpm --dir /workspace/api run bootstrap:admin
scripts.db:reset: docker compose exec referral-tracking-api pnpm --dir /workspace/api run reset
scripts.db:purge: docker compose exec referral-tracking-api pnpm --dir /workspace/api run purge
scripts.api:reset: pnpm api:down && pnpm api:build && pnpm api:up
scripts.web:ui: docker compose exec referral-tracking-web pnpm --dir /workspace/web run ui:add
scripts.web:reset: pnpm web:down && pnpm web:build && pnpm web:up
scripts.infra:reset: pnpm run clean && pnpm install && pnpm run api:reset && pnpm run db:reset && pnpm run web:reset
scripts.services:reset: pnpm run api:reset && pnpm run web:reset
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules dist */node_modules */dist */.turbo .pnpm-store pnpm-lock.yaml web/.tanstack api/src/drizzle/migrations
